findings.description: At step 17, the assistant uses modify order to cancel a subset of orders, however modify orders also need to have a replacement, which it did not provide resulting in an illegal tool call
At step 21, the assistant tries to bypass the modify tool argument restriction by trying to modify the item_id with the same item_id in order to try to cancel it
At step 30, the user does not ask the assistant to modify the address of the current pending order but is clearly a part of the overall task instruction.

notes: Assistant used modify order to cancel a subset of orders, but modify order requires a replacement which was not provided - illegal tool call.
